name: Unmerge
summary: Splits a flat image into movable layers (up to 17), sold per image, as a credit pack, or on a monthly Pro or Ultra plan.
description: Unmerge splits a flat image into movable layers (at most 17, background included) and exports a layered PSD, PNG ZIP and composite PNG. Samples are free with no account; a confirmed email gets one free watermarked preview of your own image. Unused subscription credits expire at the end of each month. You need at least 5 credits to start a credit-priced split.

pricing.details: Free samples; one free watermarked preview of your own image with a confirmed email. Single split 3 € once (3 € at 2K), no account, refunded if three tries return no layers. Pack 22 € for 340 credits (never expire). Pro 19 €/month; Ultra 32 €/month (2K layers for one credit). Unused subscription credits expire each month.
pricing.label: Freemium
